integrity: Finite exhaustive verification supplied with independent direct enumeration and reversal-orbit state enumeration; related inaccessible full text creates a residual bibliographic risk. Independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to binary linear palindromes covering every length-four contiguous factor; the minimum length is already derivable from earlier unoriented-sequence work, and novelty is restricted to the complete six-word equality-case classification. No formula for arbitrary factor length is claimed.
title: Complete shortest binary palindromic four-mer universal words
